name: HTML Formatter
description: Pretty-print, minify or validate an HTML fragment.

results.outputHint: The result can be copied directly.

hints.input: The tool parses a fragment and never wraps the content in `<html><head><body>`.
hints.action: Validate only reports whether a structure can be parsed; it does not rewrite the content.
hints.indent: The indent width is measured in spaces; 2, 4 and 8 are available.
hints.output: Format indents by depth and keeps attributes; minify strips the whitespace between tags.

faq.q: Why are syntax errors so rare?
faq.a: The HTML parser is fault tolerant and completes unclosed tags automatically, so validate really means whether a structure can be parsed.

faq.q: Can I embed the formatted HTML into a page?
faq.a: No. Formatting only rearranges tags and performs no sanitising. Escape or sanitise the HTML separately when you need XSS protection.
No. Void elements such as `br`, `img` and `input` are emitted as they are, without an end tag.
